feed.title: QuillShield blog
feed.subtitle: Our EVMbench results and plain explainers on AI smart contract audits and pull request security.

entry.title: Valid but duplicate: QuillShield on bounties and contests
entry.summary: 43 findings in 20 Solidity bug bounties and audit contests from March to November 2026. 11 valid duplicates, 8 rejected, none unique, 18 in judging.

entry.title: Our EVMbench results: 98 of 117 known vulnerabilities found
entry.summary: The QuillShield alpha found 98 of 117 known vulnerabilities on EVMbench (83.8%) in our own run on 8 July 2026. What EVMbench measures and how we ran it.

entry.title: Can AI audit smart contracts? What the data shows
entry.summary: Yes, within limits. What AI finds on a public benchmark, how many findings hold up when auditors check them, and why it does not replace a manual audit.

entry.title: AI audit vs manual audit: what each one is for
entry.summary: An AI audit reviews every change, and QuillShield tests findings with exploits where it can. A manual audit adds human judgment. How to use both.

entry.title: How to evaluate an AI smart contract auditor
entry.summary: What to ask before you trust an AI auditor with unreleased code: benchmark results, findings that hold up, proof of concept, privacy and pull requests.
